title: Generative Universal Verifier as Multimodal Meta-Reasoner

layout.note: Two columns of grey rounded category panels with centred banner titles; each panel stacks two to four uniform cards with a grey tab title, three text lines on the left and one thumbnail on the right.

lesson: Show a benchmark's scope as grey category panels that each hold uniform cards (tab title, Prompt, Answer, Explanation, thumbnail) and colour the offending phrase red so each failure reads at a glance.
